column1: # S3.A duplication needle extraction — must-match / must-not-match case table.
# The needles this produces are what the whole F4 repair searches FOR. A pattern that
# over-matches floods the receipt with junk hits and trains a reader to ignore the
# field; one that under-matches gives back the silence F4 exists to remove. Both
# polarities are therefore pinned here, and the expected NAME is asserted, not merely
# that something matched — a pattern can match the right line and capture the wrong
# group. This repository`s guard patterns have been wrong six times; a case table
# caught every one and review caught none. Read the rows, not the regex.
